combinations.name: Stimulants
combinations.description: Additive on heart rate and anxiety — caffeine on top of amphetamine or similar mostly adds jitter, not function. If a stimulant is already on board, the coffee is usually redundant.

combinations.name: Alcohol
combinations.description: Caffeine masks how drunk you feel without changing how drunk you are — the 'wide-awake drunk' effect behind energy-drink cocktails. Impairment is unchanged; awareness of it isn't.
